dialogues.speaker: View Hint
dialogues.text: The blue shall <color=#00E1FFFF>draw near to the skies</color>.

dialogues.speaker: View Hint
dialogues.text: The pale pink <color=#00E1FFFF>seeks refuge in dark corners</color>.

dialogues.speaker: View Hint
dialogues.text: The pale yellow should be a neighbor to the <color=#00E1FFFF>roots</color>.

dialogues.speaker: View Hint
dialogues.text: The two singers <color=#00E1FFFF>gaze in the direction of the voice</color>, yet none were left to sing on temple grounds.
